_about: UAE authorised-program register. An entry is only usable when status is 'active', verified_on is within 30 days, in_scope is filled in from the LIVE policy, and a copy of that policy is saved under policies/. Being UAE-based is never itself permission. Build an engine scope with: python3 scripts/uae_scope.py build <id>

programs.name: UAE National Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
programs.platform: CSC VDP Platform: https://bugbounty.ae (tester registration and approval required)
rules: Register on https://bugbounty.ae with identity and competency details, sign the NDA, give proof of UAE residency and a police clearance / good conduct certificate; test only after approval (policy 2.2.1)
Pilot phase: testers limited to authorised UAE nationals and low-risk government services; UAE residents are added after the pilot (policy section 3)
Only assets the entity has enlisted on the platform are in scope (2.2.2.3)
Prohibited: DoS/DDoS, physical testing, social engineering, persistent access, changing data, malware, brute force (2.1.1.9)
Do not intentionally access sensitive data; if you encounter PII, financial or proprietary data, stop and notify the entity and CSC (2.1.1.7, 2.3.1.2)
Stop testing and report through the platform as soon as a vulnerability is found (2.3.1.2)
Never disclose to third parties; disclosure is at CSC's and the entity's discretion; securely delete all collected data and be ready to evidence deletion (2.1.1.5, 2.1.1.8, 2.5.1.6)
programs.notes: Policy V1.0 PDF read 2026-11-24. Rewards: recognition letter (non-monetary). Reports acknowledged within 48 hours. Set status to active only after the platform approves you, and fill in scope from the assets it lists.
